promised_vs_delivered.delivered: No separate OSAT revenue breakdown reported in FIN statements or subsequent calls for FY26.
No separate PCB business revenue figures reported in FIN statements or subsequent calls.
FIN reports working capital cycle days expanded to 135.05 days in FY26, exceeding 85 days.
FY26 implied capex of ₹1,241 crore (CFO minus FCF) exceeded the ₹400 crore planned capex.
Full-year FY27 railway business growth cannot be verified yet as FY27 is ongoing in C1.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management claimed total FY26 revenue grew 33.2% year-on-year to ₹3,626.4 crore.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN reports FY26 revenue of ₹3,626 crore, representing 33.2% growth over FY25 revenue of ₹2,722 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management highlighted core EMS working capital reduction in FY26 earnings call.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN shows net working capital cycle days deteriorated from 92.88 days in FY25 to 135.05 days in FY26.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management reported Q1 FY27 revenue reached ₹946 crore, reflecting 40% year-on-year growth.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN reports Jun 2026 revenue of ₹946 crore, reflecting 40.6% growth over Jun 2025 revenue of ₹673 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management noted negative operational cash flow concerns in Q4 FY26 earnings call.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN shows FY26 cash flow from operations was negative ₹600 crore compared to negative ₹82 crore in FY25.

bull.point: Revenue grew at a 3-year CAGR of 47.7% to ₹3,626 crore in FY26, supported by an order book of ₹8,366.3 crore.
Standalone EMS business grew 53% year-on-year from ₹480 crore to ₹639 crore in Q1 FY27.
Operating profit margins remained healthy at 15.9% in FY26 and 15.6% in Q1 FY27.

bear.point: Free cash flow deteriorated to negative ₹1,841 crore in FY26 with a 3-year cash conversion of -0.707.
Working capital cycle days rose to 135.05 days in FY26 from 92.88 days in FY25, worsening cash flow.
Customer A contributed 23.99% of total sale of goods in FY26, showing significant customer concentration.

watch.point: Capex deployment progress of ₹300 crore each for OSAT and PCB facilities in FY27.
Improvement in operational cash flow and reduction of working capital cycle days from 135.05 days.
Resolution or divestment strategy regarding the underperforming smart metering business segment.
